source_name: E-data Spending API documentation (Confluence) — 'Договори' parametric API
why_relevant: Official user manual for the contracts and transactions endpoints — defines fields, filters and semantics needed to build a reliable contract-execution collector.

source_name: E-data / Прозорий бюджет platform hub (edata.gov.ua)
why_relevant: Umbrella entry point tying together Spending, OpenBudget and ProIFI; the fastest way to discover new modules, dataset releases and changes to the public-finance transparency stack.

source_name: Державна установа «Відкриті публічні фінанси» (publicfinance.gov.ua)
why_relevant: The Ministry of Finance institution that operates the E-data portals; announces API changes, outages, new datasets and methodological guidance that affect collector reliability.

source_name: OpenBudget — Державний веб-портал бюджету для громадян (openbudget.gov.ua)
why_relevant: State and local budget planning/execution by programme and economic classification; frames how much capital and maintenance budget exists at each budget holder before it converts into contracts and treasury payments.

source_name: Prozorro Contracting API (openprocurement contracting) documentation
why_relevant: Defines and exposes the contract objects behind awarded tenders — signed value, contract period, amendments (додаткові угоди) and status changes. This is the bridge between an award notice and the money actually committed.

source_name: Data.gov.ua — dataset «Інформація, що оприлюднюється згідно із Законом «Про відкритість використання публічних коштів» — Фінансові трансакції»
why_relevant: Bulk-file mirror of the treasury financial-transaction dataset on the national open data portal — useful for backfills and as a fallback when the live API is rate-limited or changed.

source_name: Data.gov.ua — «Перелік укладених договорів» via E-data API
source_subtype: open data catalogue resource / API pointer
why_relevant: The register of concluded contracts, annexes and supplementary agreements published by budget holders — captures amendments and extensions that change contract value after award.

source_name: Data.gov.ua — Звіти про виконання Державного бюджету України (State Treasury Service)
why_relevant: Treasury's own budget-execution reporting (monthly/quarterly/annual ZIP archives). Gives the macro envelope for public spending capacity that sits behind individual banking-equipment contracts.

source_name: Data.gov.ua organisation page — Державна казначейська служба України
why_relevant: Enumerates every dataset the Treasury publishes; the cheapest way to discover treasury datasets not yet on the radar (registers, classifiers, disposer directories).

source_name: Open Data Watchdog (wd.clarity-project.info) — dataset change monitoring
why_relevant: Tracks publication regularity and changes of Ukrainian open datasets, including treasury budget-execution sets — an early-warning signal when a feed we depend on stops updating or changes format.

source_name: Рахункова палата України — audit reports and open data
why_relevant: External audit of how budget funds were actually spent; audit reports occasionally itemise IT/banking-infrastructure contracts, pricing anomalies and unfulfilled contract obligations that raw payment data cannot explain.

source_name: API JSON Reader (APIJR) — third-party utility for the spending.gov.ua API
why_relevant: Community tool documenting practical query patterns against the E-data API for transactions, contracts and budget commitments — shortcut to correct endpoint usage and undocumented quirks.

source_name: Prozorro Infobox — guide 'Як знайти всі закупівлі, в яких брав участь Постачальник'
why_relevant: Official Prozorro methodology page naming the concrete tools and steps for supplier-history lookup (Clarity Project, BI Prozorro). Useful as a method reference and as a discovery route to further tooling.

source_name: Opendatabot — company pages /c/{EDRPOU}
why_relevant: Company dossiers keyed by EDRPOU combining registry data, court cases, finances and procurement signals; strong for counterparty monitoring and for resolving vendor aliases/renames of UA banking-tech suppliers.

source_name: Opendatabot API documentation
why_relevant: Documents programmatic access to EDR/USR and related registers — the machine-readable route to building a supplier universe and monitoring changes (ownership, liquidation, directors) for banking/payments vendors.

source_name: YouControl 'Аналіз тендерів' (Tender Analysis) free tool
why_relevant: Free one-click check of all participants in a given procurement, consolidating tender info and risk flags. Fast triage route from a single banking-equipment tender to the full participant set, which then seeds supplier enumeration.

source_name: YouControl catalogue of EDR-derived company data
why_relevant: Browsable catalogue of companies derived from the Unified State Register — useful for KVED-based enumeration (e.g. payment services, computer equipment wholesale) to build a candidate vendor universe before touching tender data.

source_name: VKURSI.PRO — company dossiers and Tender BI module
why_relevant: Aggregates 60+ sources per company; the VKURSI Tender BI module builds dossiers on Prozorro participants and buyers with SWOT over 50+ criteria, competitor analysis and tender participation by CPV — exactly the supplier-population inversion this cell needs.

source_name: VKURSI API repository (GitHub vkursi-pro/API)
why_relevant: Publicly documents the endpoint surface — tender analytics by period and by CPV, sanctions, founders by country, financial risk — letting us judge feasibility of automated supplier enumeration before buying access.

source_name: Єдиний державний реєстр юридичних осіб, ФОП та громадських формувань (ЄДР) — open data on data.gov.ua
why_relevant: The authoritative register underlying every commercial aggregator: legal entities, FOPs, KVED codes, ownership structure and ultimate beneficial owners. Bulk downloads, reportedly weekly-updated and free — the ground truth to which Prozorro award EDRPOUs are joined.

source_name: Ministry of Justice EDR free search (usr.minjust.gov.ua / online.minjust.gov.ua)
why_relevant: Official free lookup of a single legal entity — authoritative confirmation of name, EDRPOU, status, address and directors when an aggregator record is stale or ambiguous.

source_name: АМКУ — Зведені відомості щодо спотворення результатів торгів (annual bid-rigging offender lists)
why_relevant: Year-by-year lists of companies penalised for distorting tender results, published by the competition regulator. Names supplier entities and, read across years, exposes cartels/affiliated bidder groups — including in equipment and IT lots relevant to banking.

source_name: АМКУ — Державний реєстр суб'єктів господарювання, притягнутих до відповідальності (procurement blacklist)
why_relevant: The formal state register of entities barred from procurement for anticompetitive concerted actions — the 'чорний список АМКУ'. Directly flags which suppliers are excluded, and is a strong secondary pointer to affiliated bidder clusters.

source_name: Open Data Toolkit — 'Як перевірити, чи має компанія заборону на участь у публічних закупівлях'
why_relevant: State-backed how-to that names the exact registers and steps for screening a procurement participant — a compact map of the screening source stack for this cell.
